verdict.rationale: Kick's docs directly describe reconciliation as comparing Kick's recorded transactions against bank statements to confirm matches, missing entries, and duplicates ([kick-supp-reconciliation], [kick-docs-8]), and it supports multi-account/entity ledgers with bank feed sync via Plaid ([kick-docs-31]). However, there's no evidence of a dedicated reconciliation UI/workflow that explicitly surfaces 'matched/unmatched/duplicate' as distinct review buckets, no screenshots or hands-on account of the reconciliation screen, and no mention of statement-import matching mechanics beyond the general description. Missing for 10: concrete UI/workflow evidence of matched/unmatched/duplicate categorization surfaces, per-account reconciliation status tracking, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the reconciliation process in practice.
